set.subject: reasoning
set.title: Floor puzzle
set.stimulus:
Eight persons — A, B, C, D, E, F, G and H — live on eight different floors of a building, one person on each floor, but not necessarily in the same order. The lowermost floor is numbered 1 and the topmost floor is numbered 8. Each of them plays a different sport — Cricket, Badminton, Golf, Chess, Football, Kabaddi, Hockey and Volleyball. Each of them likes a different colour — Purple, Yellow, Brown, Grey, Orange, White, Blue and Violet.

1. G lives below the one who plays Kabaddi.
2. The one who plays Badminton likes Yellow.
3. D does not like White.
4. The one who plays Hockey lives immediately above the one who likes Brown.
5. D lives immediately below the one who likes Orange.
6. Only two persons live between the one who likes Violet and F.
7. As many persons live below C as above E.
8. F plays Kabaddi.
9. Only six persons live above B.
10. As many persons live below the one who plays Cricket as above C.
11. B likes Purple.
12. G plays Badminton.
13. D plays Football.
14. The one who plays Golf likes Violet.
15. Only one person lives between A and the one who plays Volleyball.
16. E likes Orange.
17. More than four persons live above the one who likes Grey.
